name: Marco Alting

role.en: Creative realtime 3D developer & senior frontend developer

shortBio.en: Builds realtime 3D experiences and games in Unreal Engine, and still takes on senior frontend work.
shortBio.nl: Bouwt realtime 3D-ervaringen en games in Unreal Engine, en doet daarnaast nog steeds senior frontendwerk.

en: Senior creative realtime 3D developer with a passion for game design and development using Unreal Engine, C++ and Blueprints. Also still doing projects as a senior frontend developer, including work as a senior team lead.
Plays a lot of padel in his spare time, and occasionally sings and plays guitar.
nl: Senior creative realtime 3D-developer met een passie voor gamedesign en -ontwikkeling in Unreal Engine, C++ en Blueprints. Doet daarnaast nog steeds projecten als senior frontend developer, ook als senior teamlead.
Speelt in zijn vrije tijd veel padel, en zingt en speelt af en toe gitaar.
